page_title: WHU 1-1 BHA | West Ham v Brighton 21/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
90+3' Julio Enciso (Brighton) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
90+1' Julio Enciso (Brighton) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.

90+1' Brighton are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The linesman points to the corner flag, Brighton are going to take it.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Edson Alvarez did his best and is replaced by Guido Rodriguez (West Ham).
88' An attempted cross from Julio Enciso (Brighton) is cleared.
88' The resulting set piece from West Ham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
87' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save. Corner kick. West Ham will have an opportunity.
86' A corner kick by West Ham is thwarted by the well prepared Bart Verbruggen (Brighton).
86' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
85' Substitution. Evan Ferguson (Brighton) has come on for Kaoru Mitoma.
84' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) takes out his opponent with a horrible challenge and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
81' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
81' Bart Verbruggen is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham). Easy save!
79' Oliver Scarles (West Ham) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
78' A great run by Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.
77' A long through ball into the box almost gives Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) a good chance, but he loses out to one of the defenders.
73' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
71' The substitution is prepared. Oliver Scarles (West Ham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lucas Paqueta.
71' Julen Lopetegui decides to make a substitution. Emerson will be replaced by Vladimir Coufal (West Ham).

70' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
68' We are about to witness a substitution. Yankuba Minteh is replacing Brajan Gruda (Brighton).
68' The referee allows time for a substitution. Georginio Rutter (Brighton) will be replaced by Julio Enciso.
67' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to make a change. Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) replaces Joel Veltman.
67' Brighton quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
65' 11:15 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
62' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) sends a chip pass into the box, but Lukasz Fabianski is quickest to intercept the ball.

58' 1 - 1 GOAL! Jarrod Bowen fired in an amazing shot. The goalkeeper showed his agility and punched the ball away, but only deflected it into the path of Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) and his close-range header went straight into the roof of the net. He makes it 1:1.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) replaces Niclas Fullkrug.
56' Here is a change. Mats Wieffer is going off and Fabian Hurzeler gives the last tactical orders to Yasin Ayari (Brighton).
54' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
53' Robert Jones sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
52' Wait! Referee Robert Jones has indicated he is going to review the Brighton goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
51' 0 - 1 Goal 0:1! Mats Wieffer (Brighton) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
50' A quickly taken corner by Brighton.
50' A pass into the penalty area from Joao Pedro (Brighton) is intercepted by the defence.
49' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brighton comes to nothing.
48' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brighton, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Brighton get a corner.
48' A cross from Joao Pedro (Brighton) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

47' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
46' Julen Lopetegui makes a half-time substitution. Jean-Clair Todibo comes on in place of Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham).
46' Referee Robert Jones blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Joel Veltman (Brighton) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Robert Jones ignores the protests.

45+3' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Brighton are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
42' A cross from a corner kick by West Ham is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
41' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. West Ham force a corner. They send men into the box.

40' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
39' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
35' Robert Jones shows a yellow card to Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) for his blatant foul.
35' The game is interrupted now, Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
35' The corner is swung in but West Ham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
34' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. West Ham earn a corner.
33' The ball is cleared after Joao Pedro (Brighton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
31' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
28' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
26' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for West Ham.

25' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Good work from West Ham as they win a corner.
24' Wonderful movement by West Ham. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

22' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the left side of the goal. His effort is blocked by Lukasz Fabianski with a brilliant diving save!
19' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
17' A yellow card for a tackle by Lucas Paqueta (West Ham). Robert Jones doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
17' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

16' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. West Ham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
14' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brighton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
13' Robert Jones interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Mohammed Kudus (West Ham).
12' West Ham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
11' West Ham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, West Ham are awarded a corner kick.
9' Bart Verbruggen is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham). Easy save!
8' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
6' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
2' Brighton are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. West Ham will have the kick-off.
Robert Jones was nominated as the referee for this game.
